text: Before the puja, do three rounds of anuloma viloma to settle the breath and calm the mind.
The mudra for anuloma viloma — nasagra mudra Make nasagra mudra with your right hand: Fold the index and middle fingers.
The thumb closes the right nostril; the ring and little fingers close the left.
Rest your left hand loosely on your knee.
With this same mudra, close one nostril and breathe through the other — that is anuloma viloma.
One round: Breathe in through the left nostril for six seconds, out through the right for six; then in through the right for six, and out through the left for six.
Never force or hold the breath.
Feel it: with every breath the mind grows calmer, settling onto the puja.
